rules: Every retained HTML member is bound by path, byte count, and SHA-256 in the current source manifest.
The canonical member order is the maintained bcp1928.SOURCE_PAGES order and the bundle digest is recomputed from that order.
Every page-derived collect is represented exactly once in TEI and source-accountability.json.
Trinity 23 and Trinity 24 manual claims remain unresolved until exact alternate witness bytes are retained and bound.
The independent oracle must reject source drift, accountability mutation, TEI text mutation, and schema-invalid candidates.
Technical validation does not establish CVW visual review, human acceptance, rights clearance, durable admission, or publication authorization.
